summary: No confirmed defects or release blockers found. CR5-001 holds the asset lock through reference checking and deletion, postpones locked assets, and permits cleanup for unknown assets. The UUID regex matches all generated key formats. CR5-002 invokes a separate transactional bean only on rollback; REQUIRES_NEW from afterCompletion is explicitly supported by Spring 7: https://docs.spring.io/spring-framework/docs/7.0.0/javadoc-api/org/springframework/transaction/support/TransactionSynchronization.html. PostgreSQL lock semantics checked against https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/explicit-locking.html. Runtime integration tests were not run because Java and psql are unavailable. Report files could not be written under the read-only filesystem policy.

commands.note: Matches the required final source SHA.
Reviewed changes and surrounding transaction, key-generation, cleanup, and test code.
Generated key formats and a key without a UUID behaved as expected; this does not substitute for Java integration tests.
Documentation trailing whitespace only; no release blocker.
